title: Naftifine Topical
overview: Naftifine is used for skin infections such as athlete's foot, jock itch, and ringworm.

sections.Before using naftifine,: tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to naftifine or any other drugs.tell your doctor and pharmacist what prescription and nonprescription medications, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and herbal products you are taking or plan to take.tell your doctor if you are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or are breast-feeding. If you become pregnant while using naftifine, call your doctor.
sections.Naftifine may cause side effects. If you: itchingburningirritation or stingingrednessdrynessrashIf you experience a serious side effect, you or your doctor may send a report to the Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting program online (https://www.fda.gov/Safety/MedWatch) or by phone (1-800-332-1088).
